جَاحِظَتَانِ , (so in copies of the S, and in the L,) or ↓ جِحَاظَتَانِ , (so in a copy of the S, and so accord. to a copy of the KL, in which the sing. is written جِحَاظَةٌ, though Golius, on the authority of that work, writes it جَحَاظَةٌ,) or ↓ جَحَاظَانِ , accord. to Lth, (TA,) or ↓ جَحظتانِ , (as written in one copy of the S,) The two blacks
of the eye [or rather of the two eyes]. (Lth, S, L, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
